desc:
🏝️ BUILD your ISLAND, grow your INDUSTRY, command your MILITARY, and CONQUER the seas!

⭐ HOW TO PLAY:
• Build and expand your island BASE 🏗️
• Upgrade FACTORIES and increase production 🏭
• Unlock stronger UNITS and technology 🪖
• Deploy TROOPS, VEHICLES, and defenses 💥
• RAID enemy islands and capture territory ⚔️
• DEFEND your island from attacks 🛡️
• CONQUER islands and build your EMPIRE 🌎

💰 Grow your economy, upgrade production, and unlock advanced factories.

⚔️ Train stronger troops, improve your defenses, and build a powerful military.

🌴 Attack enemy islands, expand across the archipelago, and become the strongest commander on the seas!

BUILD. DEFEND. RAID. CONQUER.

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a thumbs up!
🐞 Found a bug? Report it in the Roblox Community!
